caption: The video captures a fixed landscape view across a still lake, with no detectable movement of the camera throughout the excerpt. The upper half holds a long, rugged mountain ridge of tan and brown slopes broken by dark shrub patches, with a few snow streaks along the upper-left crest against a pale overcast sky. The lower half mirrors that same ridge in glassy dark-green water, the horizontal shoreline running through the middle of the frame. In the foreground at the bottom-left, dark conifer trees sit beside a band of dry golden tussock grass on the near shore. The reflection remains a static mirror image of the peaks rather than a separate terrain, showing no ripple, distortion, or displacement. The framing and the shoreline stay constant across the clip, presenting one continuous held interval.
